rounds.text: The business exhibits compelling growth capacity, highlighted by a 5-year compounded sales growth of 26% and screens featuring strong sales growth alongside a year-over-year sales increase of 46% [E13, E49, E50]. Underlying financial delivery shows powerful pockets of momentum, evidenced by a staggering net profit increase of 2633% year-over-year and an operating margin expansion peaking at 41% [E24, E51]. Cash generation is robustly supported by positive operating cash flow of Rs 11.60 Cr and free cash flow of Rs 0.60 Cr [E29, E30]. Market sentiment lags behind these fundamental improvements, as results score a notable 95 out of 100 with accelerating net profit while share performance and price-to-book ratios relative to sectors like 0.89x suggest untapped value [E6, E54]. Conceded: debt to equity stands high at 8.97x, and promoter holding is low at 3.86% [E31, E35].
